user.title: Lyse Charge — sign in
user.description: Sign in with your Lyse Lading account.

chargers.title: Select chargers
chargers.description: These chargers were found in your session history. Select which ones to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Lyse Charge
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again with your Lyse Lading account.

error.invalid_auth: Could not sign in — check your email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Lyse Lading.
error.no_chargers_selected: Please select at least one charger.

abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Lyse Lading account than this entry belongs to. Sign in with the original account, or add the other account as a new entry.

abort.reauth_required: Sign in again first: open the Lyse Charge re-authentication notice under Settings → Devices & services.

no_chargers.title: No chargers selected for {title}
no_chargers.description: The Lyse Charge entry {title} has no chargers, so it creates no entities. Open its options under Settings → Devices & services → Lyse Charge → Configure and select the chargers to add.
